tokens.name: cherry-500
tokens.usage: Pantone 192. THE brand cherry. Primary action fills, the Raising chip, progress fill, the one loud block per view. Never as body text on light grounds (3.0:1) — use `accent-text`. Photos may carry their own colour; the UI's only colour is cherry.

tokens.name: cherry-600
tokens.usage: Pantone 193. Hover/pressed fill of primary actions.

tokens.name: cherry-700
tokens.usage: Pantone 194. Cherry as text and focus ring on light grounds (5.8:1 on mist-100).

tokens.name: cherry-900
tokens.usage: Pantone 195. Deep cherry: danger / rejected / failed fills with white text (11.9:1).

tokens.name: slate-400
tokens.usage: Pantone 430. Disabled text and inactive marks on dark grounds only (5.7:1 on slate-900; fails on mist).

tokens.name: slate-500
tokens.usage: Pantone 431. Muted text on light grounds (5.4:1 on mist-100).

tokens.name: slate-700
tokens.usage: Pantone 432. Raised surfaces in the dark theme.

tokens.name: slate-900
tokens.usage: Pantone 433. Ink. Text, 3px borders and hard shadows in light; the page ground in dark.

tokens.name: mist-100
tokens.usage: Pantone 427. The light page ground; text on dark grounds.

tokens.name: mist-200
tokens.usage: Pantone 428. Sunken wells, table header rows, inputs' read-only fill on light.

tokens.name: mist-300
tokens.usage: Pantone 429. Soft dividers on light; muted text on dark (8.6:1 on slate-900).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Logo white. Raised cards and inputs on light; text on cherry-600/700/900.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, tables — always with a `line` border.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, wells, code/hash blocks, the striped tile.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text on surface / surface-raised / surface-sunken; 3px borders.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, table meta on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (≥4.5:1 both themes).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every structural border (3px `border-bold`) and rule.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between ledger rows only. Decorative — never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, progress fill, LIVE chip.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary action hover fill (text switches to `on-accent-strong`).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text/icons on `accent` (5.0:1). Cherry-500 takes ink text, never white (3.9:1).

tokens.name: on-accent-strong
tokens.usage: Text on `accent-hover`, cherry-700 and `danger` fills.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Cherry-coloured text and links on `surface` and `surface-raised` in light; on `surface` only in dark (3.05:1 on slate-700 — use ink there).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: FAILED / REJECTED fills and destructive confirmations, always with a word and ✕ glyph; text `on-accent-strong`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 3px focus outline, offset 3px. ≥3:1 on every surface it lands on.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-1
styles.usage: Hero line only, UPPERCASE, max 5 words. One per page.

styles.name: display-2
styles.usage: Campaign titles on detail pages, section openers. Sentence case.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page titles in app screens. Sentence case.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Card and panel titles. Sentence case.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Money is released in 3 steps, only after donors approve the receipts.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your donation stays in escrow until the campaign ends.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, chip text, table headers, eyebrows. Always UPPERCASE.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: Proof layer: the headline on-chain total or a Trust Score.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Proof layer amounts in panels (USDC, 2 decimals).

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Proof layer only: addresses, tx hashes, block numbers, USDC amounts in the ledger. Also the digits inside amount inputs.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Proof layer meta: timestamps, block numbers, formula versions.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base unit. Icon-to-text gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field internal padding, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (mobile), gaps in a row of controls. Minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (desktop), gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section inner spacing.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero padding, above display-1.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Landing-page section breaks.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, cards, inputs, chips, images. The system is square.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Only the cherry dot (status dot, avatar of an org without a logo, the logo's cherry motif).

tokens.name: shadow-hard
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and the ONE featured card per view. Hard offset, no blur, ever.

tokens.name: shadow-hard-sm
tokens.usage: Pressed/hover state of shadowed elements; secondary buttons; chips never.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Default. Most surfaces have borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: border-bold
tokens.usage: Structural border of cards, inputs, buttons, tables (in `line`).

tokens.name: border-rule
tokens.usage: Section rules and the progress threshold tick.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Ledger row dividers (in `line-soft`).
